title: Get a release to its users
goal: People can download the app and install the same version from npm.

tracks.name: Release automation
tracks.description: GitHub Actions starts on a version tag.

tracks.name: People using Staves
tracks.description: Download and installation routes inferred from the release outputs; no user interviews.

jobs.name: Make the app downloadable
jobs.outcome: A tagged version has a public release with the downloadable app attached.
doneWhen: The release action completes with staves.html attached.

tools.name: GitHub release action
tools.does: Publishes staves.html and generated release notes for the tag.
tools.limits: Does not establish that the npm publication later succeeds.

checks.rule: Tag equals package version; install, build, tests and package boundary check succeed.
checks.onFail: Later release steps are not reached.

implementation.note: Sequence exists in the pinned workflow; no execution evidence inspected.

io.staves.app.rationale: Build and validation are tasks within making the app available; they do not deliver separate user outcomes.

jobs.name: Make the package installable
jobs.outcome: People can install the tagged package version from npm.
jobs.triggerNote: After the GitHub release action succeeds.

tools.name: npm registry
tools.does: Accepts the package publication with public access and provenance, or returns an error.
tools.limits: A later publication failure does not undo the earlier GitHub release; recovery is not specified in this workflow.

implementation.note: Publication command exists in the pinned workflow; no registry failure was observed.

io.staves.app.rationale: Runs after the GitHub release action succeeds, using the tagged package built in the same automation job.

jobs.name: Choose a distribution route
jobs.outcome: A person obtains Staves through the download or package route.
doneWhen: The chosen route provides the requested version.

implementation.note: Recipient behavior is inferred from outputs; it was not observed or interviewed.

io.staves.app.rationale: One route is sufficient for a person. Matching availability across both routes is a separate release concern.

io.staves.app.origin: Code review of public .github/workflows/release.yml at v0.45.0 (622572fa61ba75b9c14d9958826d19f9aa09e09d). Draft model; no production run was inspected.

agentProgress.summary: Ready for human review. Draft source-derived model of the v0.45.0 release workflow. Recovery ownership is unresolved; no production execution was inspected.

questions.text: If npm publication fails after the GitHub release exists, who restores matching availability, and what tells people which installation route is ready? This workflow does not specify recovery.
